Golden Bike Cruise

Golden, CO · Cruiser · Social

FamilyBeginner friendly

Golden Bike Cruise is a cruiser and social group ride in Golden, CO. It rolls last Tuesday of the month at 5:30 pm from Behind the Armory building. Pace: slow cruise. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow cruise. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @goldenbikecruise the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Golden Bike Cruise group ride

A family-friendly cruiser ride on the paths and streets of Golden. Each month has a theme, and people dress up and decorate their bikes. About 100 to 150 riders of all ages come out. There's a local band, beer and burgers after. It partners with Golden nonprofits.
